failures.title: Citroen EB2ADT Engine Problems - What Actually Fails

items.title: Wet Timing Belt Degradation (The "Belt in Oil" Issue)
items.whatHappens: The EB2ADT uses a timing belt that runs inside the engine oil to reduce friction and noise. Over time, or if the incorrect engine oil specification is used, the belt material degrades and sheds rubber particles into the oil. These particles circulate and block the oil pickup strainer in the sump, leading to severe oil starvation. This often manifests first as a stiff brake pedal (due to vacuum pump starvation) before progressing to catastrophic engine bearing failure and seizure.
items.repairVsReplace: If caught early via a drop in oil pressure or brake servo issues, the sump can be removed, the strainer cleaned, and the belt replaced. However, if the engine has already suffered oil starvation damage (indicated by bearing knock), a full reconditioned Citroen EB2ADT engine replacement is the only reliable fix.

items.title: Oil Dilution from GPF Regeneration
items.whatHappens: During active Gasoline Particulate Filter (GPF) regeneration, small amounts of unburnt fuel can wash past the piston rings and dilute the engine oil. If oil change intervals are strictly followed to the standard long-life schedule, the diluted oil loses its protective properties. This accelerates wear on the turbocharger bearings and main crankshaft bearings, while simultaneously accelerating wet belt degradation.
items.repairVsReplace: This is primarily managed through strict, shortened oil change intervals (every 5,000-7,500 miles). If bearing wear has already occurred and a low oil pressure warning is present, a full engine replacement is required to guarantee reliability.

items.title: Turbocharger Wear
items.whatHappens: The turbocharger relies on a steady supply of clean oil. When the oil pickup strainer becomes partially blocked by degraded belt material, the turbo suffers from oil starvation. This leads to shaft play, excessive oil consumption, and a distinct whining noise under acceleration.
items.repairVsReplace: Replacing the turbocharger is a viable repair if caught early and the oil system is completely flushed. If the turbo has failed catastrophically and sent metal debris into the intercooler or engine, a full engine replacement is required to prevent rapid repeat failure.

failures.goodYearsLine: Post-2016 revisions of the EB2ADT saw improved belt materials and updated ECU oil-level monitoring, making them slightly less prone to rapid belt degradation. However, the fundamental "belt in oil" architecture remains a point of vigilance across all production years, and strict adherence to PSA-approved low-SAPS engine oil is non-negotiable .

variants.title: How to Confirm You Have the EB2ADT
variants.intro: As a Specific page type with no distinct sub-codes listed in the inventory, this section focuses on accurate identification and avoiding common, costly misidentifications. The EB2ADT engine code is stamped on a machined pad on the cylinder block and is also recorded on your vehicle’s V5C registration document under "Engine Number". Owners and breakers frequently confuse the EB2ADT with its lower-output siblings, the EB2DT (entry-level 100hp) and the EB2FA (naturally aspirated 82hp), or its higher-output sibling, the EB2ADTS (130hp). While all four share the same 1.2-litre 3-cylinder PureTech block architecture, the EB2ADT features a specific turbocharger size, intercooler plumbing, and distinct ECU calibration for its 110hp mid-range output. The EB2FA lacks a turbocharger entirely. Fitting an EB2DT, EB2FA, or EB2ADTS wiring harness, ECU, or ancillary components to an EB2ADT host will result in incorrect fueling, persistent fault codes, and a non-running vehicle.

buyingGuide.title: Buying a Replacement EB2ADT - What to Choose

options.label: Used
options.body: A used Citroen EB2ADT engine for sale can be a viable, budget-friendly option for older C3 or C4 projects, but it carries a severe inherent risk. Unless the seller can provide documented proof that the wet timing belt has been replaced recently with the correct PSA-approved part, and the oil pickup strainer has been inspected and cleaned, you are highly likely to be inheriting a ticking time bomb of belt degradation. Learn more about used engines.

options.label: Reconditioned
options.body: For most owners, a reconditioned Citroen EB2ADT is the only sensible choice. A proper recon will proactively address the engine’s known weaknesses by fitting a brand-new timing belt kit, replacing the tensioners, ensuring the oil pickup strainer is completely free of debris, and verifying the health of the turbocharger, delivering peace of mind for the future. Explore reconditioned engine options.

options.label: Rebuilt
options.body: A full rebuild is justified for low-mileage C4 Picasso or late-model C4 projects where the engine is being stripped to the bare block. This allows for new piston rings to address any oil consumption, comprehensive decarbonisation, and verification of the turbocharger, ensuring the engine matches the pristine condition of the host chassis. View rebuilt engine services.

buyingGuide.supplyFitLine: Sourcing and fitting your replacement through our vetted network ensures the work is completed by specialists familiar with PSA PureTech systems and wet-belt procedures, backed by a nationwide warranty. Check supply and fit availability.
buyingGuide.vehicleValueNote: Citroen C3, C4, and C4 Picasso models (2014-2018) typically hold values between £3,000 and £10,000, depending heavily on age, mileage, and body condition . Because a fully fitted, reconditioned Citroen EB2ADT engine replacement can approach £2,850, it is crucial to evaluate the vehicle's overall condition before committing to a major mechanical investment. Older C3 models valued under £3,500 frequently sit at the scrap threshold. If the lowest viable replacement cost exceeds approximately 60% of the vehicle's current market value, evaluate scrap value first.

items.question: What is the most common failure on the Citroen EB2ADT engine?
items.answer: The most critical failure on the EB2ADT is wet timing belt degradation, where the belt material breaks down and sheds rubber particles into the engine oil. These particles block the oil pickup strainer, leading to severe oil starvation and catastrophic engine bearing failure. A stiff brake pedal (due to vacuum pump starvation) or a cold-start rattle are primary early warning signs. Oil dilution from GPF regeneration can also accelerate bearing wear if service intervals are not strictly shortened.

items.question: Which Citroen models use the EB2ADT engine?
items.answer: The EB2ADT 1.2-litre PureTech turbo petrol engine was fitted to the Citroen C3, C4, and C4 Picasso between 2014 and 2018. It served as the mid-output 110hp petrol powerplant across these family cars and compact MPVs. It was designed to replace older, thirstier engines with improved fuel economy, lower emissions, and a refined three-cylinder character.

items.question: Should I buy a used or reconditioned EB2ADT engine?
items.answer: For any modern Citroen, a reconditioned EB2ADT is strongly recommended over a used unit due to the high risk of wet-belt failure. Used engines almost always inherit the same degraded timing belt or blocked oil pickup strainer that caused the original removal. A proper reconditioned build proactively installs a brand-new, PSA-approved timing belt kit, replaces the tensioners, and ensures the oil pickup strainer is completely clear. Reconditioned units also include comprehensive compression and oil pressure testing to guarantee reliability.

items.question: How do I know if my car has the EB2ADT engine?
items.answer: You can confirm your engine code by checking the V5C registration document under the "Engine Number" field or by locating the code stamped on the cylinder block. The EB2ADT is easily distinguished from the entry-level EB2DT (100hp) and the high-output EB2ADTS (130hp) by its specific turbocharger size and ECU calibration. It is also distinct from the naturally aspirated EB2FA (82hp), which lacks a turbocharger entirely. Fitting an EB2DT, EB2FA, or EB2ADTS wiring harness or ECU to an EB2ADT host will result in incorrect fueling, persistent fault codes, and a non-running vehicle.
